ownership: Empty barrier requires both consumers. S2 releases the prior stage after the next group0 wait1; final wait0 releases the final stage. S1 drains/releases current. Raw TMA completion precedes decode, decode completion precedes A loads. Next tile may stream before both consumer epilogues finish; gated arm waits for both.
limitation: Models ownership and forward progress under variable completion order. Native TMA proxy visibility, instruction semantics, register reallocation and Hopper two-slot execution require H200.
